title: Warm Spiced Moroccan Lamb Mrouzia
description: A traditional Moroccan dish featuring tender lamb, green olives, and a blend of aromatic spices, served with a side of crusty bread for a satisfying meal prep option. This sour and cheesy meal is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the lamb to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, and dried ginger, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the green olives, chicken broth, honey, salt, and black pepper to the pot, and stir to combine.
Cover the pot with a piece of parchment paper, creating a papillote, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the lamb with a side of crusty bread, and enjoy the sour and cheesy flavors of the mrouzia.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
